concept: Alphabet Animals ABC - each letter paired with a matching animal
title: Alphabet Animals ABC Coloring Book for Toddlers: Big Letters, Bold Lines, and Cute Animals for Ages 2-5
subtitle: A Fun ABC Learning Coloring Book with Extra-Bold Outlines, Large Uppercase Letters, and Adorable Animals for Preschool Boys and Girls
description:
Make learning the alphabet FUN with adorable animals!

This engaging ABC coloring book features 50 bold and easy coloring pages designed specifically for little hands ages 2-5. Each page pairs a big uppercase letter with a cute, friendly animal — from A is for Alligator to Z is for Zebra, plus 24 bonus animal pages for extra coloring fun!

What makes this coloring book special:

  • Extra-bold, thick outlines perfect for toddlers and preschoolers
  • Large, simple designs ideal for crayons, markers, and colored pencils
  • Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through
  • 26 alphabet letter pages + 24 bonus animal activity pages
  • Educational AND fun — learn letters while coloring!

Perfect for back to school, quiet time, road trips, or rainy day activities. Makes a wonderful gift for birthdays, holidays, or just because!

Grab your crayons and let's learn the ABCs!
